raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 onward includes collector 'v2' rows whose txn_ts is UTC, while legacy rows are America/Chicago local time. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time fixes the 00:00-06:00 clustering and moves the 36 rows misdated to 2026-01-19 back to their correct local dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
